title: Laughing Baby in Vintage Pram Carriage, 1950s Deckled Snapshot Photo
description: A delightful mid-20th-century snapshot capturing a laughing infant sitting up happily in a classic vintage pram or baby stroller. Positioned outdoors against a textured dark brick wall and beside foliage, the baby's joyful expression radiates through slight motion blur. The print features classic deckled scalloped edges, and the reverse displays horizontal adhesive or corrugated storage markings.
